mintAuthority.summary: earnUSD is an upgradeable tokenized ShareManager for Lido/Mellow protocol strategies. Base USDC minting remains inherited from Circle; local queues/vault create shares and the observed 5-of-8 Proxy Admin Safe can replace share logic. The curator is currently 3-of-6, not the published 3-of-5.
